about: Whether a thread waits on the user, and whether it holds an offer. global_orchestrator::waiting_kind and offer_of (Rust) and waitingKindOf and offerOf (ui/global-chat.js) read these cases in their tests, so the orchestrator's waiting() tool and the sidebar's Waiting on you list agree. Each view is a TabView laid over base. `waits` is the blocked kind (a pending question or approval, or a failure), and `ask` says which of the two a `needs_input` is, `approval` or `question` (absent otherwise): a finished turn that ended asking something never waits. `offer` is true when the finished turn's last paragraph question still stands at `now`.
